title: Celastrol attenuates ferroptosis-mediated intestinal ischemia/reperfusion-induced acute lung injury via Hippo-YAP signaling.
authors: Fan, Xin; Ai, Yinxin; Mu, Guo; Wang, Feixiang; Feng, Jianguo; Jia, Jing; Chen, Ye; Zhou, Jun
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Celastrol通过Hippo-YAP信号通路减轻肠缺血再灌注诱导的急性肺损伤中的铁死亡，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Acute lung injury commonly arises as a secondary complication following intestinal ischemia/reperfusion (II/R) injury. Celastrol (CEL), recognized for its therapeutic effects on inflammation-related conditions such as acute lung injury. Its protective efficacy against II/R-induced acute lung injury remains insufficiently investigated. The Hippo-YAP signaling pathway regulates ferroptosis and plays a pivotal role in II/R injury. PURPOSE: To evaluate whether CEL can activate the Hippo-YAP signaling pathway, suppress ferroptosis, and mitigate II/R-induced acute lung injury. METHODS: Firstly, an II/R model in mice was established, Immunofluorescence staining and Western blot were used to evaluate the effects of CEL on the Hippo signaling pathway and ferroptosis regulation. Network pharmacology predicted the relevance of the Hippo-YAP signaling pathway in CEL's improvement of acute lung injury. Molecular docking experiment indicated that CEL binds effectively to yes-associated protein (YAP), and overexpression of YAP significantly alleviated both lung injury and ferroptosis. Furthermore, the oxygen-glucose deprivation/recovery (OGD/R) model of MLE-12 cells was developed to further confirm CEL's inhibition of ferroptosis via the Hippo-YAP signaling pathway. RESULTS: CEL ameliorated II/R-induced acute lung injury and inhibited inflammation. In vivo and in vitro studies further revealed that CEL significantly reduced ferroptosis and reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation in the lung epithelial cells. CONCLUSION: CEL effectively mitigated ferroptosis and II/R-induced acute lung injury through elevating YAP protein level, reducing lipid peroxidation, and decreasing intracellular iron accumulation. This study highlights CEL's therapeutic potential for inhibiting ferroptosis, provides mechanistic insights to support CEL's broader therapeutic utility.
abstract_zh: 背景：急性肺损伤通常作为肠缺血/再灌注（II/R）损伤后的继发性并发症出现。雷公藤红素（CEL）因其对急性肺损伤等炎症相关疾病的治疗作用而受到认可，但其对II/R诱导的急性肺损伤的保护效果尚未得到充分研究。Hippo-YAP信号通路调控铁死亡，并在II/R损伤中发挥关键作用。目的：评估CEL是否能激活Hippo-YAP信号通路、抑制铁死亡，并减轻II/R诱导的急性肺损伤。方法：首先，建立小鼠II/R模型，使用免疫荧光染色和Western blot评估CEL对Hippo信号通路和铁死亡调控的影响。网络药理学预测了Hippo-YAP信号通路在CEL改善急性肺损伤中的相关性。分子对接实验表明，CEL能有效结合Yes相关蛋白（YAP），且YAP过表达显著减轻了肺损伤和铁死亡。此外，建立MLE-12细胞的氧糖剥夺/恢复（OGD/R）模型，以进一步确认CEL通过Hippo-YAP信号通路抑制铁死亡。结果：CEL改善了II/R诱导的急性肺损伤并抑制了炎症。体内和体外研究进一步揭示，CEL显著减少了肺上皮细胞中的铁死亡和活性氧（ROS）积累。结论：CEL通过提高YAP蛋白水平、减少脂质过氧化和降低细胞内铁积累，有效减轻了铁死亡和II/R诱导的急性肺损伤。本研究强调了CEL抑制铁死亡的治疗潜力，为支持CEL更广泛的治疗应用提供了机制性见解。
